challenges.title: Burp Suite-CTF
challenges.tagline: Act as an external red teamer investigating the fintech company MegaCorp. Every flag needs Burp Suite Community Edition and nothing else.
description: A whistleblower has hidden flags across MegaCorp's infrastructure and you have been hired to recover them. The one rule: if a flag can be reached without touching a specific Burp Community feature, the challenge has failed its purpose.

The CTF is split into six self-contained missions of roughly three to five hours each, because Burp Community cannot save projects. Every mission's flags are locked in as you go, so a crash only costs the mission you were in. By the final flag you will have used every tool in Burp Suite Community at least once.
learn: Proxy: interception, history filters, match and replace, WebSockets
Repeater and Inspector: chaining requests, race conditions, request smuggling
Intruder: throttle-aware attacks with small, smart wordlists
Sequencer, Decoder and Comparer: session analysis and multi-layer decoding
Logger, Organizer, DOM Invader, Clickbandit and BApp extensions
requirements: Burp Suite Community Edition (pre-installed on Kali Linux)
Docker with Compose v2.17 or newer
Roughly 4 GB of free RAM and a few GB of disk for lab images
Firefox, Chrome, Edge or Brave for the launcher extension

labs.title: Mission 1: Setup & Recon
labs.summary: Configure Burp against MegaCorp's fussy environments: CA certificates, listeners, client certs, SOCKS upstream, NTLM, HTTP/2.

labs.title: Mission 2: Interception & History
labs.summary: Manipulate live traffic and dig through proxy history: role tampering, WebSockets, match and replace rules.

labs.title: Mission 3: Repeater & Inspector
labs.summary: Surgical exploitation of the API and payment services: chained calls, race conditions, request smuggling.

labs.title: Mission 4: Intruder Mastery
labs.summary: Brute-force work sized for Community's throttled Intruder: PINs, pitchfork attacks, token chains.

labs.title: Mission 5: Sequencer, Decoder, Comparer & Sessions
labs.summary: Cryptographic and session-layer analysis of MegaCorp's token handling, macros and cookie jar.

labs.title: Mission 6: Client-Side, Extensions & Finale
labs.summary: DOM XSS, clickjacking, Logger-only flags, JWT forging, then decrypt the CEO's secret.
